scope: Read-only independent review of frozen v007 first native GPU candidate. Only these two report files were added.
review_basis: all eight actual 4x nearest PNG previews
raw RGBA alpha rows and separate alpha components
actual pose projection and renderer source
not_claimed: animated GIF playback was not visually observed
single alpha component does not prove believable joints
rig lengths and encoding checks do not approve art
positive_observations: Head/chest identity and original glove design remain stable at 1x/4x
Brass wrist tool stays on anatomical left / viewer right in every frame
There are two alternating lifted-leg halves, with no dominant one-sided limp
observed_art_failures: f01 and f05 contain true transparent knee separations
Other frames still have thin/dark visible shoulder and hip connections
Foot front/back separation is weak in contact poses
Passing poses read mainly as vertical shortening / in-place lifting; clear bend and weight transfer are insufficient

inferred_causes.evidence: Source y65 knee rim is assigned to thigh; y66..70 assigned to knee whose parent is shin. Adjacent rim rows undergo different affine projections.
inferred_causes.scope: The rim interpretation is visual/semantic; alpha gap coordinates are direct measurements.

inferred_causes.evidence: 4x4 knee cap centered near projected knee y70 starts near y68, and does not reach the thigh endpoint above the transparent y67 row.
Front XY projection discards Z; all keypoint X coordinates are fixed. Depth-changing swing is therefore mostly invisible.

frames.art_observation: 接触姿势前后脚关系弱；鞋底位置与 f04 相同，主要差异是膝和腕的小幅纵向变化。
真实透明断裂：机器人右腿、观众左侧，在 y67 分离；下半腿独立。
抬脚成立；通过姿势仍像直柱缩短，膝弯和穿过身体的动作不清楚。
缺少清楚的前摆与即将落脚形体；区别主要是纵向缩短。
另一半步接触成立，但与 f00 前后脚形体差异弱。
真实透明断裂：机器人左腿、观众右侧，在 y67 分离；下半腿独立。
抬起另一侧脚；与 f02 相同，形体仍缺少可见的通过与前后摆。
回到 f00 时没有清楚的前摆落脚；没有单独的大幅循环跳帧，但闭环步态不够可读。

v008_recommendations.projection: screen_y=model_y+0.65*model_z; keep root anchor [32,80]; register model ground y80 and projected sole positions separately
v008_recommendations.source_split: Reassign only enumerated semantic knee-rim pixels at source y65 from thigh to knee, and tibial endpoint pixels at y70 from knee to shin. Preserve every RGBA byte and unique pixel ownership.
v008_recommendations.knee_sleeve: Author once: medium steel 4px section, upper insertion about 4px and lower insertion 2px around the knee axis. Upper/lower sleeves follow their own fixed bones and overlap the axis; no output-alpha-dependent repair.
v008_recommendations.draw_order: old inner dark core < fixed continuous steel sleeves < rigid original patella/armor rim; retain only single-sided sleeve shadow and keep it from covering all medium steel width.
v008_recommendations.validation: Re-review actual native and 4x PNGs, local joint continuity, visible sleeve thickness, contact/passing/up phases and 7->0/3->4 transitions. Do not substitute component/encoding passes for art judgment.
